bbaf95c5c5951167.notes:
- Cuttlefish use millions of pigment-filled cells called chromatophores controlled directly by motor neurons in the brain
- The dynamic passing cloud display creates a stroboscopic optical illusion that overloads the visual cortex of prey like crabs
- Visual camouflage works even though cuttlefish are completely colorblind, detecting polarization patterns instead

668532a58b2f4f3e.notes:
